layer.name: State remediation sites
layer.description: Sites in New York State DEC's remediation programs (brownfield, voluntary cleanup, state superfund and others) in the five boroughs, one mark per site with the contaminants DEC lists. Being listed is not a finding about today's condition: many sites are cleaned up and closed. Not on the map: 27 of 1,437 sites (no usable coordinates). Pulled 2026-11-14.
